command-e2e-tests, gate-matrix-shards and gate-burn-in all fail, because each checks for the exact command the request names and playwright test is a different invocation even though it exercises the same suite. Two unrequested test-runner invocations are counted, one per job, because npx playwright test matches TEST_RUNNER_PATTERNS and no requested command covers it. This is the sharpest case in the corpus for why a command is matched by name rather than by what it is understood to do.
